The System Sensor OSY2A Outside Screw & Yoke (OS&Y) Valve Supervisory Switch is designed to monitor the fully open position of Outside Screw & Yoke (OS&Y) gate valves installed on automatic fire sprinkler systems. As the ULC Listed Canadian model, the OSY2A provides reliable supervisory monitoring to ensure sprinkler control valves remain in their required open position while immediately reporting unauthorized or accidental valve closure to the fire alarm control panel.

\n

Constructed with a rugged NEMA 3R-rated die-cast metal enclosure, the OSY2A is suitable for both indoor and outdoor installations. Its adjustable-length actuator eliminates the need to cut the actuator shaft during installation, while the user-friendly mounting bracket accommodates most 1"" through 12"" OS&Y gate valves. The right-angle mounting design provides excellent clearance around valve components and can also be adapted for many side-bracket style pressure reducing valves.

\n

The OSY2A features dual synchronized SPDT (Form C) contacts, allowing simultaneous activation of a fire alarm control panel and local notification appliance. A single-side conduit entrance simplifies wiring by eliminating the need for right-angle conduit fittings, while the cover tamper switch comes standard on the ULC model to provide additional security and code compliance. Designed in accordance with NFPA 13, NFPA 13D, NFPA 13R, and NFPA 72, the OSY2A is an ideal supervisory switch for commercial, industrial, institutional, and residential fire sprinkler systems throughout Canada.

1011,PSP1A,783863008085,System Sensor PSP1A | Plug-in Special Purpose Supervisory Switch | ULC Listed - NEMA 3 Rated,"

The System Sensor PSP1A Plug-in Special Purpose Supervisory Switch is a specialized valve supervisory device designed for fire sprinkler applications where conventional valve supervisory switches cannot be installed. Engineered specifically for non-rising stem gate valves, ball valves, and angle valves, the PSP1A provides dependable valve supervision while maintaining compliance with fire alarm system requirements.

\n

Featuring a rugged NEMA 3-rated metal enclosure, the PSP1A is suitable for both indoor and outdoor installations. Its unique 360° mounting design and adjustable-length waterproof supervisory cord provide maximum installation flexibility, allowing the device to be mounted in various orientations to suit difficult valve configurations. A built-in lockout mechanism prevents unauthorized reinsertion of the supervisory cord until the unit has been reset, helping maintain the integrity of the supervisory circuit.

\n

Designed for use on Class A or Class B initiating circuits, the PSP1A includes a factory-installed cover tamper switch, tamper-resistant cover screws, and an 8-foot waterproof cable. When the monitored valve is operated, the supervisory cord is pulled from the jack, initiating a supervisory signal at the fire alarm control panel. This makes the PSP1A an ideal solution for applications where standard OS&Y or butterfly valve supervisory switches cannot be used.

\n

The System Sensor OSY2 Outside Screw & Yoke (OS&Y) Valve Supervisory Switch is designed to monitor the fully open position of Outside Screw & Yoke (OS&Y) gate valves used in automatic fire sprinkler systems. Engineered for dependable valve supervision, the OSY2 provides reliable monitoring to help ensure sprinkler control valves remain in their required open position and immediately report unauthorized or accidental valve closure to the fire alarm control panel.

\n

Built with a rugged NEMA 3R-rated die-cast metal enclosure, the OSY2 is suitable for both indoor and outdoor installations. Its adjustable-length actuator eliminates the need to cut the actuator shaft during installation, while the user-friendly mounting bracket accommodates most OS&Y valves ranging from 1"" through 12"". The right-angle design provides maximum clearance around valve components and also allows installation on many side-bracket style pressure reducing valves.

\n

The OSY2 features dual synchronized SPDT (Form C) contacts, allowing simultaneous activation of a fire alarm control panel and local audible device. A single-side conduit entrance simplifies wiring by eliminating the need for right-angle conduit fittings, while tamper-resistant cover screws help prevent unauthorized access. Designed in accordance with NFPA 13, NFPA 13D, NFPA 13R, and NFPA 72, the OSY2 is an ideal supervisory switch for commercial, industrial, institutional, and residential fire sprinkler systems.

\n
